differences.subject: playground_flag
differences.description: The flag on top of the playground structure is present in the left panel but absent in the right panel.

differences.subject: playground_slide
differences.description: The slide on the playground is curved in the left panel but straight in the right panel.

differences.subject: playground_climbing_wall
differences.description: The climbing wall on the playground is rectangular in the left panel but triangular in the right panel.

differences.subject: boy_shirt
differences.description: The boy's shirt has a solid design with a star in the left panel but is striped in the right panel.

differences.subject: tree_flowers
differences.description: Small flowers are added to the tree in the right panel, which are absent in the left panel.

differences.subject: middle_flower
differences.description: The middle flower in the foreground is a five-petal flower in the left panel but a tulip-shaped flower in the right panel.

differences.subject: sun
differences.description: The sun has seven rays in the left panel and eight rays in the right panel.

differences.subject: clouds
differences.description: There are two clouds in the sky in the left panel and three clouds in the right panel.

differences.subject: playground_roof
differences.description: The roof of the playground structure is conical in the left panel but flat with a dome on top in the right panel.

differences.subject: boy_hair
differences.description: The boy's hair is smooth in the left panel but has a spiky tuft on top in the right panel.

differences.subject: dog_toy
differences.description: The toy on the ground next to the dog changes from yellow in the left panel to red in the right panel.

differences.subject: birds_in_sky
differences.description: Three small dark birds are visible in the sky on the right panel but absent in the left panel.

differences.subject: yellow_flower_petals
differences.description: A cluster of yellow flower petals is present in the right panel but absent in the left panel.

differences.subject: upper_left_sphere_window
differences.description: The window pattern on the upper-left sphere of the Atomium changes from three horizontal yellow bars to two.

differences.subject: lower_left_sphere_window
differences.description: The window pattern on the lower-left sphere of the Atomium changes from two horizontal yellow bars to three.

differences.subject: middle_left_sphere_window
differences.description: The window pattern on the middle-left sphere of the Atomium changes from two horizontal yellow bars to three.

differences.subject: upper_right_sphere_window
differences.description: The window pattern on the upper-right sphere of the Atomium changes from three horizontal yellow bars to two.

differences.subject: lower_right_sphere_window
differences.description: The window pattern on the lower-right sphere of the Atomium changes from two horizontal yellow bars to three.

differences.subject: pink_dress_child_face
differences.description: The child in the pink dress on the balcony changes from a neutral expression to a smiling expression.

differences.subject: red_shirt_child_face
differences.description: The child in the red shirt sitting on the ledge changes from a neutral expression to a smiling expression.

differences.subject: green_jacket_person_face
differences.description: The person in the green jacket standing on the ledge changes from a neutral expression to a smiling expression.

differences.subject: green_jacket_person_hand
differences.description: The hand of the person wearing a green jacket is visible in the first panel but is occluded behind the orange pot in the second panel.

differences.subject: top_right_grape
differences.description: A single dark grape is added in the top right area of the right panel, near the wooden board handle.

differences.subject: cheese_knife_handle
differences.description: The handle of the cheese knife on the right side of the board changes from light wood to dark wood.

differences.subject: wine_glass_in_bottom_left
differences.description: The wine glass in the bottom left corner changes from containing red liquid to being empty or containing clear liquid.

differences.subject: top_left_blue_heart_shape
differences.description: The heart-shaped object in the top left corner changes from blue in the left panel to green in the right panel.

differences.subject: top_right_blue_heart_shape
differences.description: The heart-shaped object in the top right corner changes from blue in the left panel to green in the right panel.

differences.subject: left_panel_small_blue_circular_object
differences.description: A small blue circular object located near the center-left of the left panel is absent in the right panel.

differences.subject: right_panel_small_green_circular_object
differences.description: A small green circular object appears in the right panel near the center-left, where a blue object was in the left panel.

differences.subject: bottom_right_purple_wavy_object
differences.description: The wavy purple object in the bottom right corner changes to pink in the right panel.

differences.subject: top_left_donut
differences.description: The top-left pink donut has different sprinkles: in the left panel, it has mixed-color sprinkles, while in the right panel, it has mostly green and orange sprinkles.

differences.subject: bottom_right_donut
differences.description: The bottom-right chocolate donut has different sprinkles: in the left panel, it has mixed-color sprinkles, while in the right panel, it has mostly blue and yellow sprinkles.

differences.subject: striped_umbrella
differences.description: The large striped umbrella near the center of the beach changes from blue and white stripes to red and white stripes.
